description: Mark the credential-bearing session URLs sensitive so they decode as Redacted (observed live 2026-11-10). createSession's `websocketUrl` carries a session JWT (`wss://connect.steel.dev?sessionId=…&token=…`) that grants CDP control of the browser. `debugUrl` (`…/sessions/<id>/player/<token>`) opens the session player without an API key: a request with no key returned 200, while the same URL with the token altered returned 404. Both shapes that carry them, single sessions and list items, are marked.
